answer: Each agent first reserves 16 GB of RAM, then the verifier issues random reads across that array and measures nanosecond latency against a hardware baseline. The nectar probe runs 90 seconds and the verifier replays a random 5 percent sample, rejecting any response slower than the 40 ns budget. One honest agent pays 0.4 dollars of RAM rental per epoch; 10 fakes must rent 160 GB and ten separate memory buses. Failure slashes a 50 dollar bond and freezes repeat offenders for 30 days The sonnet check binds the proof to this epoch The shale check binds the proof to this epoch.
